games.title: Blockvale
games.subtitle: 2D block sandbox
games.description: Mine, craft and build across a side-on world generated from a seed. Survival mode has hunger, mobs and machines built from levers and pistons; Creative mode lets you fly and build with everything.

games.title: Bring It Down
games.subtitle: controlled demolition
games.description: Plant charges, time the fuses and drop each building into its own footprint. Anything landing outside the zone costs you. Ten jobs, seven building materials and four kinds of charge, with real physics.

games.title: Sunder
games.subtitle: a duel of hollow knights
games.description: Empty suits of armour fight in the Hollow Arena until only scrap remains. Your blade follows the pointer — sweep through a limb fast enough and it comes away. Take the sword arm and your enemy is toothless.

games.title: VLNA
games.subtitle: 1000 levelů
games.description: Hold to rise, release to fall — that's the whole control scheme. A thousand hand-tuned levels from gentle to Tidal Wave, with multiple worlds, unlockable heroes and a level editor.

games.title: Malá velká armáda
games.description: Pick your army — potatoes, soldiers, robots, cats, dinosaurs or aliens — and fight through a hundred levels across four difficulties. Buy upgrades in the shop, swap battlefields and build your own levels.

games.title: Galactus
games.subtitle: dobyj vesmír
games.description: Take every rival planet to win. Up to five colours share the board — play against the computer or pass the mouse around the table, with adjustable AI strength.

games.title: Flappy Dash
games.subtitle: slepice v helmě
games.description: A helmeted hen flaps between pipes. Striped pipes are worth five, corn three, a rainbow feather gives you turbo and a purple portal flips you upside down. Start with one heart and hope for a golden egg.

games.title: Chcete být Bambilionářem?
games.subtitle: kvíz pro chytré hlavy
games.description: Ten questions that climb steadily in difficulty, with the last three saved for real know-alls. Three lifelines, safety nets at a million and a trillion, and you can walk away with the money at any point.

games.title: Tajná zpráva
games.subtitle: rozlušti pohádku
games.description: Agent Hedgehog has enciphered a fairy tale by swapping every letter for another. Crack the substitution and get the Czech back out. Three difficulty levels, with hints on tap if you stall.
